question.prompt: At the same time in sunlight, an object 3 m tall casts a shadow 2 m long, and another object casts a shadow 5 m long. Find the height of the other object. (Unit: m)

solutions.explanation: Sunlight produces parallel projection, so object height is proportional to shadow length: \(3/2=h/5\), giving \(h=7.5\).
solutions.title: Height-to-shadow proportion
